name: driveiq
description: Your vehicle's service history, reminders and manuals in one place, with an assistant that answers from your own documents. Runs on your own Cloudflare account.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Anthropic API key, used for Aiana's answers. Create one at [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys). It's stored as an encrypted secret on your Worker.

CLAUDE_MODEL.description: The Claude model Aiana uses. The default works well for answering from your own documents.

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: Name of the Cloudflare AI Gateway to route Claude calls through. `default` is created automatically on first use.
